interventions.detail: Used Python 3.10 venv via uv; old pins (opencv<=4.6.0.66, librosa 0.8.1, imageio 2.9.0) don't install on system Python 3.12
Docs install paddlepaddle from mirror.baidu.com/pypi/simple, which no longer serves it; used PyPI paddlepaddle==2.6.2 CPU
Installed setuptools<70 because paddle imports setuptools at import time
Pinned numpy<2 for compatibility with opencv-python 4.6 / librosa 0.8.1
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0 so that cv2 can be imported
animegan_predictor.py: no_grad + cap inference resolution to 768px max side; full-res CPU forward OOMs (>12GB) / segfaults in Im2Col
